newsitem.title: USA: Shoe Carnival ready to speed up expansion.
newsitem.headline: Shoe Carnival ready to speed up expansion.

text.p: Shoe Carnival Inc said Thursday it plans to accelerate its expansion after it substantially completed its remodeling program in the second quarter.
The footwear retailer, with 91 locations in the Midwest and mid-South, did not open any new stores in the quarter ended August 2.

"The fundamentals of the company are sound, our balance sheet is strong and we are now ready to accelerate our store expansion," Mark Lemond, chief executive officer, said in a news release. "In the second half of 1997 we are scheduled to open four stores and we anticipate opening 15 to 20 stores in fiscal 1998."
The company also plans to close four lower volume stores later this year when their leases expire, Lemond said.
Earlier Thursday, the company reported net income of $2.0 million, or $0.15 a share, for the second quarter, compared to $891,000, or $0.07 a share, a year ago.
Shoe Carnival shares rose 3/8 to 11-1/8 Thursday.
